title: Agnus Dei (Hérissant, Missa Quandiu vivam soli Deo serviam)
desc: Jean Hérissant, Missa Quandiu vivam soli Deo serviam, Agnus Dei, before 1558. 5 voices (Superius, 2m. Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0031_5); edited by Marie Breillat, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
